summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py, exported it (plus alias generalized_wasserstein_dice) from monai/losses/__init__.py, and documented it in docs/source/losses.rst. Nothing was run, so the code is verified by reading only. The loss form (alpha_il = 1 - sum_k M[k,l] p_ik, then generalized Dice between g and alpha) and the weighting modes ("default" = 1/(sum g)^2, "uniform") were written from memory of Fidon et al. 2017 and should be checked against issue #601. No tests were added and nothing was committed.
